prompt.input: Explain to a customer why they have been reccomended a specific Health Insurance {{Policy}} given the information we were provided from the customer. Provide how we arrived at the decision given their {{Age}}, {{Dependents}}, and {{Physical Activity Level}}. The physical activity level is based on a scale of 1 to 5 with 5 being extremely active and 1 being minimal physical activity a day. Be as precise as possible and avoid any harsh language.
prompt.instruction: You are generating a short explanation as to how a customer was reccomended a certain Health Insurance Policy level. You will always be extremely professional and kind.Only use the variables that have been defined here, do not add any additional features.
